activity: First spring inspection. Check stores. Feed if honey < 3kg.
Check for swarming mood. Add super if > 8 frames of bees.
Place supers for acacia flow. Widen entrance. Do not disturb during flow.
Harvest acacia honey. Check queen. Prepare for linden flow.
Harvest linden honey. Start varroa treatment (formic acid). Remove super.
Continue varroa treatment. Begin autumn feeding.
Complete autumn feeding (15-18kg sugar). Reduce entrances.
Oxalic acid drip if broodless. Install mouse guard.
Winter oxalic acid treatment (sublimation). Leave hives undisturbed.
Do not open hives. Monitor weight (min 20kg with bees).
Italian starts earlier. First inspection. Watch for already active development.
Italian grows fast - add super earlier. Less prone to swarming.
Buckfast: active development begins. Gentle inspection. Less swarming tendency.
